notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just writing a really quick devlog to let you know I've uploaded a new build of [i]In Fair Spirits[/i] that fixes a handful of typos which were pointed out to me by eagle-eyed readers, plus it fixes a minor bug with Lisbeth's blinking animation.

I hope you enjoy it, and feel free to let me know if you find anything else strange in the game!

- ebi x
